message.zodNoHttp: ZodError without HTTP context. See console for details.

compile.imageMissing: Image {{image}} is not installed — open Settings → Images and click «Install».

code.docker_unavailable: Docker is unavailable — start Docker Desktop.
code.image_missing: The Docker image is not installed.
code.compile_setup_error: The build environment is not ready.
code.not_self_updatable: This build does not support self-update.
code.url_invalid: The repository address is not valid.
code.url_scheme_forbidden: This kind of address is not supported. Use https or ssh.
code.credential_invalid: The access details are not valid.
code.credential_in_use: This access is used by projects, detach it first.
code.credential_host_mismatch: This access was created for a different server.
code.credentials_missing: The repository needs access: add a token or a key.
code.secrets_unavailable: The secret store is unavailable, saved tokens cannot be read.
code.store_untrusted: The project history settings look foreign. Reset them, the history stays intact.
code.profile_required: Set your author name and e-mail first: they go into the published versions.
code.auth_failed: The server rejected the access. Check the token or the key.
code.forbidden_write: This access has no write permission for the repository.
code.sso_required: The organization requires SSO: authorize the token for it on the server.
code.not_found_or_no_access: The repository was not found or you have no access to it.
code.rate_limited: The server asks to wait: too many requests.
code.host_key_unknown: The server key is not confirmed yet. Compare the fingerprint and confirm it.
code.host_key_changed: The server key has changed. This may be spoofing, check the fingerprint.
code.offline: The server is unreachable. Check the network and the address.
code.tls_error: The server certificate could not be verified.
code.timeout: The server did not respond in time. Try again.
code.ssh_unavailable: ssh is not installed. Install an OpenSSH client or use https.
code.git_unavailable: Git was not found. Install Git or use the Studio image.
code.branch_missing: The repository has no such branch.
code.remote_exists: A repository is already connected. Disconnect it to connect another.
code.not_a_studio_project: The repository does not contain a Studio project.
code.unrelated_histories: The repository history is unrelated to the project history.
code.project_exists: This project already exists on this computer.
code.folder_not_empty: The folder is not empty. Pick an empty or a new one.
code.sync_busy_build: A build is running, the sync will start after it.
code.off_branch: The project is not on its working branch. Switch back and retry.
code.sync_incomplete: The previous sync did not finish. Wait for recovery and retry.
code.plan_outdated: The data changed since the conflicts were shown. Refresh the list and recheck your choices.
code.invalid_resolution: The chosen resolution does not fit this file.
code.unresolved_markers: The text still contains conflict markers.
code.remote_moved: The repository changed during the push. Sync again.
code.protected_branch: The branch is protected: direct pushes are not allowed.
code.large_file: The history has a file larger than the server limit.
code.workflow_scope_missing: The token has no permission to change workflow files.
code.email_privacy: The server hides e-mails. Use a no-reply address in your profile or allow a public e-mail.
code.remote_schema_newer: The project in the repository was written by a newer Studio. Update the Studio.
code.bundle_invalid: The file is not a project bundle.
code.bundle_password_required: The bundle is encrypted, a password is required.
code.bundle_prerequisites_missing: The bundle lacks the history it is built on.
code.operation_not_cancellable: This operation can no longer be cancelled.
